# u dont GRC me

> A control-centric GRC prototype. Controls are the primary source of truth; assets, framework requirements, evidence, risks, vendors, integrations, and AI agent decisions all hang off a control and are explained by traversing to it. React/Vite front end, SQLite locally, a read-only Lambda/DynamoDB Governance API when hosted.

This is a portfolio prototype, not a production assurance platform. The data is seeded demo data. Writes are disabled on the hosted API; they work only against a local `npm run dev:full` instance, behind an optional bearer token.

## Hosted surfaces

- [Application](https://xnasusx.github.io/u-dont-grc-me/): the product itself, primary deployment on GitHub Pages
- [Portfolio](https://xnasusx.github.io/u-dont-grc-me/portfolio/): recruiter-facing summary of the work
- [Governance API](https://fvtqz3hs2ohvappyrcya2oats40sodrc.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/api/governance): read-only control graph snapshot, JSON
- [API health](https://fvtqz3hs2ohvappyrcya2oats40sodrc.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/api/health): hosted API metadata

## Machine-readable artifacts

- [OSCAL component-definition](https://xnasusx.github.io/u-dont-grc-me/oscal/component-definition.json): the control inventory as OSCAL 1.1.2. Each control is a `process` component; each framework mapping is an `implemented-requirement` carrying coverage percentage, mapping confidence, and approval state. UUIDs are RFC 4122 v5 and stable across exports. Regenerate with `npm run export:oscal`.

## Local API

Run `npm run dev:full` for the UI on `http://127.0.0.1:5173` and the API on `http://127.0.0.1:8787`.

- `GET /api/governance`: full snapshot — controls, frameworks, requirements, mappings, assets, policies, evidence, FAIR scenarios and runs, mutation audit log
- `GET /api/controls/:id`: one control with its mappings, assets, evidence, and policies
- `PATCH /api/controls/:id`: edit allowlisted control metadata (local only)
- `GET /api/fair-settings` and `PUT /api/fair-settings/:controlId`: FAIR assumptions
- `POST /api/fair-simulation-runs/:controlId`: persist a backend-computed Monte Carlo run
- `GET /api/scf/coverage`: every requirement with the SCF controls that crosswalk to it, plus how many of our controls actively claim it
- `GET /api/scf/controls/:id`: one Secure Controls Framework control

## Data provenance

- [Secure Controls Framework](https://securecontrolsframework.com) via [GRCEngClub/scf-api](https://github.com/GRCEngClub/scf-api). CC BY-ND; titles and descriptions are reproduced verbatim and never rewritten. Synced by `npm run sync:scf`.
- [how-to-harden](https://github.com/grcengineering/how-to-harden), MIT. SaaS hardening guides. Synced by `npm run sync:hardening`.
- [nthpartyfinder](https://github.com/grcengineering/nthpartyfinder), MIT. Nth-party vendor discovery. Synced by `npm run sync:nthparty`.

Full notices in [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](https://github.com/xnasusx/u-dont-grc-me/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).
